snippet.title: Hero of Law - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
This fanmade mod for _The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time_ can be obtained here: https://www.newerteam.com/hol/

Please note that we do not distribute any ROM files. You must provide your own legitimate copy of the game to apply the patch to.
